meta.title: Fireworks Industry — Whizzzest
meta.description: Learn how Wanzai’s fireworks industry grew from a traditional craft into a major part of the county’s economy and visitor events.

hero.title: Fireworks industry
hero.subtitle: From a traditional craft to a major local industry

history.title: A craft passed down through generations
paras: Local accounts trace Wanzai’s fireworks craft to the Tang dynasty and its expansion to the Song. The Wanzai County Annals describe a busy trade during the Qing dynasty, with firecrackers sold to Guangdong, Fujian and other provinces. By the early Republican period, hundreds of workshops were operating in the county.

Two Wanzai firecracker brands, Tongxinmao and Zhenshengwan, received certificates at a Hangzhou exhibition in 1936. Wanzai fireworks later appeared at events including the Beijing Olympics and the Shanghai World Expo.

blocks.title: Scale
paras: Wanzai’s fireworks industry spans manufacturing, trade, logistics and professional displays. The county fireworks chamber reported output of 23.3 billion yuan across the industry in 2024.
Fireworks support local jobs in factories and in businesses that supply, package, transport and stage the products.

blocks.title: Markets
paras: Wanzai producers sell thousands of products, from traditional firecrackers to fireworks for public shows, in China and overseas.
Recorded exports date back to the 1960s. Wanzai products now reach markets in the Americas, Europe and Southeast Asia.

blocks.title: Technology and innovation
paras: The county has backed manufacturing upgrades with an emphasis on safety and product standards.
Manufacturers have introduced automation and developed products for professional displays.
Jiangxi recognized the Wanzai fireworks cluster in 2024. Its supply chain includes manufacturing, professional display companies, logistics and testing.

cultureTourism.title: Culture meets tourism
paras: Wanzai has brought its fireworks craft into the visitor experience through public displays at Wanzai Ancient City and Longhu Park.
Wanzai Ancient City is a nationally rated 4A scenic area centered on a group of ancestral halls. Visitors can explore the halls, then stay for an evening display when one is scheduled.
The old town was among China’s first designated areas for nighttime culture and tourism.
cultureTourism.alt: Silver fireworks fan out over the old town at night

future.title: Looking ahead
paras: Wanzai plans to expand trade and develop new products and visitor experiences, alongside manufacturing upgrades.
The county is linking industrial development with efforts to pass on the traditional craft.
